overview.firstRunCopy: Bring the local workspace, dataset, knowledge base, model route, and document-QA agent online.
overview.localFlowCopy: Phase 1.2 focuses on document-QA operations, model catalog visibility, route status, trace review, and configuration placeholders.
overview.workspaceSnapshotCopy: Live identifiers from bootstrap are shown after onboarding.

datasets.documentSourcesCopy: Upload, inspect ingestion status, and manage document assets when backend controls are present.
datasets.noDocumentsCopy: Upload a document or refresh after a backend document list endpoint is added.

playground.askCopy: Tune retrieval depth and answer visibility before asking the local document-QA agent.
playground.citationsCopy: Client-side thresholding controls what counts as answerable evidence.
playground.noChunksCopy: Lower the score threshold or increase Top K to inspect more evidence.

traces.recentRunsCopy: Playground and agent invocations with trace ids, latency, fallback mode, and citation counts.
traces.noRunsCopy: Ask a question in the playground to create the first traceable run.
traces.traceDetailCopy: Raw trace metadata stays collapsed into dense operational fields.

modelCatalog.summaryCopy: The UI reads platform catalog contracts when available, then falls back to the seeded provider reference so the page remains useful before backend endpoints land.
modelCatalog.enabledProvidersDetail: Enabled flag is shown when returned by the provider or route API.
modelCatalog.routesLoadedDetail: Loaded from model-routes or catalog payload.
modelCatalog.routesFallbackDetail: Route fallback is waiting for the platform API.
modelCatalog.providersCopy: Use case, tradeoff, cost, privacy, lock-in, key mode, and capabilities per provider.
modelCatalog.routesCopy: Route selector is shared with Builder and Playground status displays.
modelCatalog.localOllamaCopy: Local route availability is explicit even when the dedicated backend status endpoint is missing.
modelCatalog.pricesCopy: Exact prices come from platform snapshots. Qualitative cost is shown while that endpoint is pending.
modelCatalog.healthCopy: Endpoint status is separated from fallback catalog rendering so missing APIs are visible but non-blocking.

deployments.localApiCopy: Invocation snippet with optional API key header placeholder.
deployments.sampleQuestion: What does this document say about refunds?
deployments.apiKeyMessageFallback: Run onboarding to create or confirm the local bootstrap key placeholder.
deployments.widgetConfigCopy: Local embed placeholder values for future hosted widget contracts.
deployments.title: Title
deployments.widgetFooter: Allowed-origin allowlist and rate-limit policy placeholders remain required before hosted widget activation.

settings.devControlsCopy: Local seed/reset controls report backend availability without requiring new routes.
settings.apiKeyMessageFallback: Bootstrap key status appears after onboarding.

evals.evalGatesCopy: Eval gates block promotion until configured thresholds are met.

wallet.walletIdFallback: Run onboarding to create the local wallet placeholder.
wallet.paymentPlaceholder: Provider and Turkish payment methods are configuration placeholders only.
wallet.readOnlyCopy: No payment capture, credits, reservations, or real provider charges are executed in this phase.

builder.documentQaCopy: Builder route selection is displayed without changing the saved demo agent contract.
builder.agentIdFallback: Run onboarding to create the local agent.
builder.retrieval: Retrieval: pgvector top-k with deterministic local hash embeddings.
builder.answerMode: Answer mode: Ollama when enabled, otherwise extractive fallback with citations.
builder.trainingLabCopy: Classifiers and regressors can be trained from CSV datasets in the Training Lab.

chat.noAnswer: No answer is shown because the best retrieved chunk is below the configured score threshold.

overview.title: Operator overview
overview.summary: Control surface for local document-QA operations, dev setup, RAG quality checks, trace review, and placeholders.
overview.emptyCopy: Trace, eval, deployment, and billing events will appear here after service contracts are connected.

stack-chooser.title: Stack chooser
stack-chooser.summary: Provider, runtime, storage, vector, evaluation, and deployment choices grouped for an agent workspace.
stack-chooser.emptyCopy: Templates will be listed once the platform API can persist workspace stack choices.

builder.title: Agent builder
builder.summary: Document-QA agent configuration linked to the local route, dataset, and knowledge base.
builder.emptyCopy: Draft summaries will appear here after the builder save contract is available.
secondaryItems: Needs draft save and publish actions

model-catalog.title: Model catalog
model-catalog.summary: Provider comparison, route status, local Ollama readiness, price snapshots, and endpoint health.
model-catalog.emptyCopy: Provider reference cards are shown even when catalog endpoints are not available.
secondaryItems: Provider endpoint can replace fallback cards
Price snapshots can replace qualitative costs
Local model status endpoint can replace inferred readiness

playground.title: Playground
playground.summary: Prompt and RAG quality test surface for validating local document-QA behavior before promotion.
playground.emptyCopy: Runs will appear after the AI service invocation path is available.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.summary: Workspace for document upload, inferred document inventory, delete/reingest controls, and ingestion status.
datasets.emptyCopy: Data assets will appear here after import and catalog endpoints are connected.

evals.title: Evals
evals.summary: Evaluation suite list for acceptance gates, regression checks, scoring, and release readiness.
evals.emptyCopy: Suites and latest scores will appear once evaluation contracts are available.

traces.title: Traces
traces.summary: Operational trace stream for prompts, tools, model routing, identity, policy, costs, and failures.
traces.emptyCopy: Trace records will appear after playground and deployed agents emit telemetry.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.summary: Local invocation, API key, and embeddable widget configuration placeholders.
deployments.emptyCopy: Deployment cards will appear once agents can be promoted to a target runtime.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.summary: Reserved operator view for credits, budgets, provider spend limits, and prepaid balance status.
wallet.emptyCopy: Ledger activity will appear after billing configuration and usage metering are connected.

billing.title: Billing
billing.summary: Plan, invoice, payment, tax, and usage metering placeholder for the commercial control path.
billing.emptyCopy: Billing records will appear after payment provider configuration is completed.

training.title: Training Lab
training.summary: Create training jobs for classifiers and regressors, monitor progress, and register model versions.
training.emptyCopy: Training jobs will appear after you create a dataset and start a classifier training job.

settings.title: Settings
settings.summary: Workspace administration placeholder for dev controls, identity, policy, keys, retention, and environment settings.
settings.emptyCopy: Workspace settings will appear after identity and policy APIs are connected.

platformApi.label: Platform API
platformApi.detail: Web requests under /api/platform route to the local platform service.

aiService.label: AI service
aiService.detail: Web requests under /api/ai route to the local AI service.

bootstrap.label: Bootstrap
bootstrap.detail: Creates the local workspace, project, route, dataset, knowledge base, agent, wallet, and API key.

devSeedReset.label: Dev seed/reset
devSeedReset.detail: Seed falls back to local bootstrap; reset reports backend availability when the dev endpoint is missing.

modelRoute.label: Model route
modelRoute.detail: Ollama is seeded as the default route, with extractive fallback when no model is reachable.

agentDefinition.label: Agent definition
agentDefinition.detail: The bootstrap flow creates a document-QA agent linked to the default knowledge base.

billingPlaceholders.label: Billing config placeholders
billingPlaceholders.detail: Wallet and billing views reserve plan, wallet, and payment settings.

docsExamples.label: Docs and examples
docsExamples.detail: A support policy sample document is available for smoke testing the document-QA flow.

ragQuality.label: RAG quality controls
ragQuality.detail: Top K, score threshold, and no-answer visibility are exposed in the playground.

workspaceMode.label: Workspace mode
workspaceMode.detail: Document upload, RAG chat, training, evals, traces, and snippets are available locally.

serviceProxies.label: Service proxies
serviceProxies.detail: /api/platform and /api/ai are routed by Next rewrites.

launchScope.label: Launch scope
launchScope.detail: Document-QA operations, model catalog UI, route status, defensive dev controls, and trace polish.

billingState.label: Billing state
billingState.detail: Wallet and billing paths exist without payment execution.

runOnboarding.label: Run onboarding
runOnboarding.detail: Create or confirm the local workspace, route, dataset, knowledge base, agent, wallet, and API key.

uploadDocuments.label: Upload documents
uploadDocuments.detail: Add .txt, .md, or .pdf documents and track inferred document assets from ingestion jobs.

askPlayground.label: Ask in playground
askPlayground.detail: Use cited extractive RAG locally, or Ollama when it is enabled and reachable.

reviewTraces.label: Review traces
reviewTraces.detail: Check answer, retrieved chunks, citations, run id, trace id, latency, cost, and trace metadata.

trainClassifier.label: Train a classifier
trainClassifier.detail: Upload a CSV dataset and train a scikit-learn classifier from the Training Lab.

registerModel.label: Register model version
registerModel.detail: Save trained artifacts to the model registry with candidate/staging/production aliases.
